# Om Surve

> Founder and CEO of Ayu Health, an EHR-agnostic AI clinical intelligence layer for Indian doctors, and VP of AI at FusionCyber. Backend, cloud and AI engineer; previously ML research on OCR for Indian-language manuscripts at IIT Bombay.
